thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Tenant-specific quality degradation detected: tenant 'BetaFin' on dedicated-pool eu-west-1b after quant-profile rollout (q3_1_fast).

oncall-jordan: got paged. Brief summary?

cust-ops-sim: BetaFin reported a bunch of terse/incomplete answers starting ~2025-11-03 07:40 UTC. No 5xx spike, but several customer logs flagged low-confidence tokens.

eng-ml-mei: correlating now. We pushed q3_1_fast to eu-west-1b at 05:12 UTC. Cluster-wide evals are OK, but tenant scoped eval for BetaFin shows BLEU/QA drop ~40%.

oncall-jordan: is this isolation or cross-tenant?

eng-ml-mei: looks isolated to BetaFin. Other tenants on the same pool fine. Suggest per-tenant rollback to previous stable profile q8_fp16_safe.

pm-rafa: BetaFin is on an enterprise contract. Need an ETA and a short customer message.

oncall-jordan: mitigation plan: 1) create routing override + pin variant for BetaFin to q8_fp16_safe. 2) run a 10% canary for 15 minutes. 3) if metrics improve, promote to 100% for tenant. 4) capture logs and open postmortem.

eng-ml-mei: agree. Using tenant-scoped operations to avoid touching other customers. I'll prepare commands.

infra-lee: standing by to approve any pool reloads; watchout for memory delta with q8_fp16_safe.

eng-ml-mei: commands:
```
# set tenant routing override to safe quant/profile
redwoodctl routing override set --tenant BetaFin --pool eu-west-1b --model rdx-llama-v2-13b --variant quant:q8_fp16_safe --scope tenant
# create canary for 10% traffic
redwoodctl canary create --tenant BetaFin --pool eu-west-1b --model rdx-llama-v2-13b --variant quant:q8_fp16_safe --traffic 10% --duration 15m
```

oncall-jordan: can we sample a few live requests for quick sanity?

cust-ops-sim: I'll open a customer-facing line: "We're investigating degraded response quality and applying a targeted rollback for your traffic; we expect improvement within ~30 minutes. We'll follow up with details." Sending now.

pm-rafa: good. Keep it concise and clear. Offer a follow-up postmortem.

incident-bot: oncall handoff note: next oncall is infra-lee in 1h 20m.

eng-ml-mei: canary started at 07:58 UTC. Initial telemetry: per-tenant eval score improved on canary samples (BLEU +18), sample outputs look restored. Latency +12% on canary hosts.

infra-lee: memory usage +6% on canary worker but within reserve. No OOMs.

oncall-jordan: after 10 minutes canary: quality metrics trending positive. Recommend promote.

eng-ml-mei: promoting override to 100% for BetaFin on eu-west-1b. Applying graceful worker reload to pick up variant.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: override applied, reload enqueued for 8 workers.

cust-ops-sim: updated BetaFin: "Rollback applied; you should see normal behavior. We're monitoring and will send confirmation when fully stable."

eng-ml-mei: quick regression checks: other tenants on the same pool show no quality degradation post-override. Isolation validated.

oncall-jordan: acceptance criteria to close paging:
- BetaFin QA/BLEU back within 5% of baseline for last 24h.
- Support confirmation from BetaFin they see improved outputs.
- No collateral regressions for other tenants.

infra-lee: will keep watch for the next 3 hours for memory/cpu drift; if BetaFin load spikes we might need to autoscale.

cust-ops-sim: BetaFin confirmed improvement at 08:21 UTC and asked for a timeline on permanent fix and assurances against recurrence.

pm-rafa: I'll draft a customer follow-up with timeline and mitigations. Offer an optional consultation to adjust prompt patterns if helpful.

eng-ml-mei: preliminary root cause: q3_1_fast applies more aggressive per-kernel approximations in attention and alters token rounding; for BetaFin's templates this reduced model fidelity. Action items: immediate rollback of q3_1_fast global rollout, add per-tenant preview + automatic per-tenant eval gates, expand canary duration and include tenant-specific prompt suites, instrument quant profile changes with prompt-sensitivity tests.

oncall-jordan: severity set to Sev3 (customer-impact, mitigated) in the incident tracker.

incident-bot: Created incident record: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1919991111

eng-ml-mei: I'll lead the postmortem. Draft due EOD +2, final in 7 days.

infra-lee: taking the monitoring watch for next 4 hours. If anything pops, page me on #pager.

oncall-jordan: handing off to infra-lee. Closing active paging loop. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
